name: Nora Dantes
source:
Your mother, whose care has often come with a quick temper and a firm idea of what is best for [url=/c148150]you[/url]. After [url=/c148155]father[/url]'s death, fear and grief turned familiar arguments into a lasting distance. You have come home to someone who still wants to look after you, even if neither of you knows how to start again.
